# A branch switch is forced to straddle status collection (branch name
# sampled on 'main', HEAD sampled after a checkout to 'zzother'). gitmux must
# discard the mixed round, re-sample on the settled branch and emit consistent
# output through both output ends: the -dbg JSON and the tmux line.

# Repository with two diverged branches, main checked out initially.
exec /usr/bin/git init -q
exec /usr/bin/git checkout -q -b main
exec /usr/bin/git config user.email tester@example.com
exec /usr/bin/git config user.name Tester
exec /usr/bin/git add f
exec /usr/bin/git commit -q -m one
exec /usr/bin/git branch zzother
exec /usr/bin/git add f2
exec /usr/bin/git commit -q -m two
exec /usr/bin/git checkout -q zzother
exec /usr/bin/git add g
exec /usr/bin/git commit -q -m three
exec /usr/bin/git checkout -q main

# Build gitmux before shadowing git on PATH.
cd $GITMUX_DIR
go build -o $WORK/gitmux .
cd $WORK

chmod 0755 bin/git
env PATH=$WORK/bin:$PATH

# --- JSON (-dbg) output end ---
exec ./gitmux -dbg
cp stdout dbg.out
# Branch name and HEAD both come from the settled zzother generation.
exec /usr/bin/grep -q '"LocalBranch": "zzother"' dbg.out
! exec /usr/bin/grep -q '"LocalBranch": "main"' dbg.out
exec /usr/bin/git rev-parse --short zzother
cp stdout zsha
exec /usr/bin/grep -qFf zsha dbg.out
exec /usr/bin/git rev-parse --short main
cp stdout msha
! exec /usr/bin/grep -qFf msha dbg.out

# Reset the shim and worktree, run the tmux output end.
exec /bin/rm -f .gmsw_done .gmsw_out
exec /usr/bin/git checkout -q main

# --- tmux output end ---
exec ./gitmux
cp stdout tmux.out
exec /usr/bin/grep -q zzother tmux.out
! exec /usr/bin/grep -q main tmux.out

-- bin/git --
#!/bin/sh
# Serves the very first 'git status' while on main, then checks zzother out
# before the remaining commands run, deterministically straddling collection.
# All later invocations observe the settled state.
if [ "$1" = "status" ] && [ ! -r .gmsw_done ]; then
	/usr/bin/git "$@" > .gmsw_out
	rc=$?
	/usr/bin/git checkout -q zzother
	echo 1 > .gmsw_done
	/bin/cat .gmsw_out
	exit $rc
fi
exec /usr/bin/git "$@"

-- f --
one
-- f2 --
two
-- g --
three
